data.content:
Oxford United welcome Wigan Athletic to the Kassam Stadium on Tuesday evening for their latest instalment of League One action in the 2026-27 campaign.

In their previous outing, the U’s were held to an entertaining 1-1 draw by Mansfield Town at the One Call Stadium, while the Latics ended their four-match winless streak in the league by beating Reading 1-0 on home soil.
